cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Mika 和 agent-desktop
同日涨星过千,前 13 天每天只有 1–4 颗
cover.dek: 手机端和桌面端的 computer use 项目同时冒头,日增分别是 +1,840 和 +1,755。其中 agent-desktop 在 X 上几乎没人推,涨得有点意外。
cover.title_en:
Mika and agent-desktop
both jump past 1,000 stars a day
cover.dek_en: Phone and desktop computer-use projects took off on the same day, at +1,840 and +1,755 stars. agent-desktop got almost no promotion on X, and for its first 13 days it gained only 1 to 4 stars daily.

stickers.title: 成本新玩家
stickers.text: microsoft/TokenEconomizer 三天日增从 +205 到 +1,515,总星 2,712。
stickers.text_en: microsoft/TokenEconomizer went from +205 to +1,515 stars a day over three days, now at 2,712 total.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 同一份 skill 对强模型有益,对弱模型反而有害,见 2610.33024。
stickers.text_en: One skill helps strong models and hurts weak ones, per 2610.33024.

stickers.title: 缓存差距
stickers.text: 冷前缀请求首 token 约 69.4 秒,高复用请求只要约 2.8 秒。
stickers.text_en: A cold-prefix request takes about 69.4 s to first token, a high-reuse one about 2.8 s.
